column1: # Replay of the cc auto-update ledger, 2026-08-27 .. 2026-09-27, through the
# your-org/nexus-code#1657 hold policy. ONE ROW PER FIRE DAY: the day's final
# outcome under the OLD code, and the STRUCTURED FACTS that outcome carried.
# Source: the primary clone's monitor/.state/cc-auto-update/decisions.tsv (145
# rows in the window) and the gate logs / findings files beside it.
# ROUND 2 (skeptic F4): the first cut SUPPLIED an issue and a control for all
# five holds, and no historical row carries both. The block facts below now
# carry ONLY what exists, each field with its SOURCE in the last column:
#   evidence  the scenario a row names (its gate-2.1.x.log `failed:` line), or
#             the findings file a row cites (findings-2.1.x.md);
#   issue     only when THAT DAY's row names it (250/251/252 name none; the
#             #1112 link arrived in a later correction row and is NOT used);
#   control   only when that day's row or findings text states a baseline that
#             passed (250: "2.1.247 GREEN 7/7" in the row, gate-2.1.247-0828.log
#             GREEN 7/7; 278: "2.1.273 … 27/27 arms pass" in its findings).
# So 2.1.278 holds on a COMPLETE contract, and 250/251/252/281 hold through
# the FAIL DIRECTION — evidence named, contract incomplete → hold + defect —
# never through a field the replay invented. `-` means the source has none.
# facts vocabulary (what test-cc-hold-policy.sh feeds to the REAL functions):
#   block:<evidence>|<issue>|<control>        a block the evaluator recorded
#   control-shared:<control-log>              the evaluator judged the RED not
